title: fix(Pagination): add `autohideContainerHOC` to <Pagination /> (#2296)
body:
* fix(Pagination): add `autohideContainerHOC` to <Pagination />
* fix(pagination): export RawPagination along with Pagination
  This way the tests can be executed without having to test
  autohideContainer.
author: Maxime Janton
